eventUi.kitImageHelp: Shown to the athlete in the public form when they choose this kit.
eventUi.kitImageAfterSave: Save the kit first to be able to upload its image.
eventUi.serviceFeeHelp: Added to the final price of this event. It starts with the Configuration value when the event is created and is independent afterwards. If you change it, payment QRs already generated no longer match the final price and must be regenerated; existing registrations keep their amount.
